adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a real issue in parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts. The function uses APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED (a global config) to decide which schema to use for parsing. Looking at the diff, Salesforce's CalendarService.ts calls parseRefreshTokenResponse() after making a direct fetch to 'https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token' - it doesn't use refreshOAuthTokens(). However, if APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true globally, parseRefreshTokenResponse will use minimumTokenResponseSchema instead of the salesforceTokenSchema passed as the second argument. This means Salesforce responses would be parsed with the wrong schema just because credential sharing is enabled for other apps. The schema selection should be based on the actual source of the response, not a global flag.
